notes.title: Harvest Reloaded - July Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4JIc9xc07fg;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings Junkyard Warriors!

The Harvest Reloaded game mode was announced 2 weeks ago. Since then there's been some major changes! The UI has been overhauled to include better graphics and a game speed adjustment for those of you with machines that bring the power! Better path graphics have been introduced as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533325/ecfd531a28f347c113b1953ca8700361bf220ef1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533325/2c947b09cd47f9a084e6f0567c6faef413d8894b.png

So far no changes on towers and enemies - yet! All 3 enemy and 5 tower types from the base game mode have been ported over. In addition as of this writing 4 additional tower types are slated to be added, so keep an eye out for future updates! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533325/bdf9a161d57a3a33ea8726c91b82ddff97496b83.png

Some changes have also been made to the way mines operate. Instead of harvesting trash piles directly, mines harvest cells of trash - which are what the green icons surrounding the mine represent. The red icons around the mine represent trash cells destroyed by enemies. For easier recognition of areas being mined, borders were added. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533325/90bf88fba7194ca2158cafd94171061bd8389b57.png

ETA for the new game mode to drop as of this writing is still August 15th. In the meantime, keep your eyes open for updates!

notes.title: Major Update Incoming!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42533325/220208d2bb736bf98f7f00455ed2e3dd47916493.gif

Greetings Junkyard Warriors!

First off, I'd like to thank the players who have provided feedback and suggestions for this game.
This is the first game I've ever developed and am always looking to improve things.

Speaking of suggestions, something I've noticed players requesting is additional content. Fortunately another game mode (or rather extension of the base game mode) is in the works! Improvements to the game engine have been made to allow bigger maps to be generated, towers and enemies to be more easily added, and improved efficiency which will make the new game mode possible.

In the new game mode, Harvest Reloaded, you'll have to manage and defend multiple mines from an endless onslaught of enemies as you clear the map, just like the base game mode. Also, as requested, new towers and enemies are in the works as well! The gif shows the current state of the new game mode as of this writing. The tentative date for rollout of the new game mode is August 15th.
